event_summary: A white textured sheet moves down into a shallow dish of blue liquid, folds over, and becomes mostly lying in the liquid.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a white shallow dish containing blue liquid on a wooden tabletop, while a white textured sheet is suspended above it from a partly visible orange-and-black holder. After an interval with little visible change, the sheet descends into the dish, contacts the blue liquid, stands partly upright, then bends and folds down across the liquid surface. The orange-and-black holder remains above the dish after the sheet separates from it. Later, most of the sheet appears flat and partly covered by the blue liquid, with only pale edges or corners still clearly visible.

reasons: The dish and blue liquid are clearly visible.
The suspended white sheet is visible but its upper part is cropped by the top edge of the frame.
The orange-and-black holder is only partly visible near the top edge.
